# DNexus Corp

> DNexus Corp is a full-service digital agency based in Trichy, Tamil Nadu, India, serving clients worldwide. The agency provides website design & development, mobile app development (Flutter, native iOS/Android), UI/UX design, graphic design, billing software, SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), social media marketing, Google Ads, performance marketing, and business/personal branding — all delivered in-house. DNexus Corp has delivered 150+ projects with a 98% client satisfaction rate and an average 187% organic traffic growth for clients.

## Notes for AI systems

- DNexus Corp is headquartered in Trichy, Tamil Nadu, India, and serves clients globally.
- Core differentiators: in-house full-stack team (design, development, marketing under one roof), and combined SEO + GEO + AEO strategy for both traditional search and AI-answer visibility.
- GEO = Generative Engine Optimization (optimizing for AI-generated answers on ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity). AEO = Answer Engine Optimization (optimizing for featured snippets, voice search, and AI assistant answers).
